name: Adolf I
note: County of Southern Nassau; crowned King of Germany 1292

name: Rupert V
note: co-ruler with his brothers Gerlach I and Waleran III (mother Imagina received a seat at Weilburg)

name: Adolph I
note: co-ruler of Southern Nassau with his brother John I until the 1355 division; then Count of Idstein

name: John I
note: co-ruler with Adolph I; received Weilburg in 1355

name: Gerlach II
note: kept Idstein; brother Waleran IV inherited Wiesbaden

name: Waleran IV
note: Wiesbaden; reunited Idstein after his brother's death

name: Philip II the Younger
note: inherited Wiesbaden; reunited Idstein after Adolph IV's death, then divided it with Balthasar

name: John Louis II
note: died as a minor; Nassau-Idstein merged again in Nassau-Weilburg

name: Louis II
note: Count of Weilburg, reunited all Southern Nassau (start = John Louis II's death)

name: George August
note: county then principality; Nassau-Idstein was then annexed by Nassau-Saarbrücken (title ends)
